comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
On 0.26.0 every devenv pane sat `unreachable` for 10+ minutes. The window's own ssh master died (`daemon.control.ended`, then `daemon.start_again.waiting`), and in the same second a different master appeared on Muster's control path `$TMPDIR/muster-<pid>-devenv.ctl`: ppid 1 (a ControlPersist fork), no `-L` (the forwarded `.sock` refused, os error 61) and no `-R`. Because `-O check` answered `Master running`, the supervisor logged no `tunnel.down` and never respawned; instead `daemon.remote.starting` ran every ~30 s and failed with "another daemon is already serving" while the far daemon was healthy. Nothing in crates/muster-ssh or muster-daemon was found that would create that master; the user's ssh config had `ControlMaster auto` / `ControlPersist 10m` for the host.

Fix: stop treating "something answers `-O check`" as our tunnel being up - also watch the spawned child, or probe the forward itself, and on a mismatch `-O exit` whatever holds the path and respawn. A start refused with "already serving" over and over is a second sign the tunnel, not the daemon, is broken. Minor: the devenv's daemon directory held ~30 stale `window-release-*.sock` files.

Where: crates/muster-ssh/src/tunnel.rs (`master_answers`, the supervise loop), crates/muster-seam/src/session/starting_again.rs. Related: a_2J1KZ9FbM, a_2shK7DirB. From tooling feedback a_2ydQrEjuc (high).
title: A foreign ssh master on the tunnel's control path holds every devenv pane unreachable
